acceptanceCriteria: Each reader uses a LimitReader of bound+1 (or a size check before reading) and refuses over-bound input with its existing code.
opencodequalification decodes evidence rows with unknown fields refused or explicitly documented as accepted.
A focused test per reader feeds bound+1 bytes.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the V1-0712 output-class inventory (docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0712-output-class-inventory.md), source origin/main a2615609. Confirmed from source, runtime NOT_RUN. These readers ingest host- or model-produced evidence and enforce a size limit only after reading everything: opencodequalification readRows (native.go:17) os.ReadFile then checks 16 MiB, and record.go readObject is unbounded and decodes without DisallowUnknownFields; doccorpus loadInput (compile.go, about L356-381) reads the whole Git blob before the MaxProviderBytes check; evalrepo loadTraceFixture (fixture.go:44) reads an agent trace fixture with unbounded os.ReadFile (traces are capped at 1000 after decode). Same class as V1-0691.

AC1 met. AC2 met: unknown members in OpenCode qualification rows are explicitly documented as accepted (decode comment, AHI-032 row) and asserted by a test. AC3 met: TestEvidenceReadsRefuseOverBoundFiles, TestLoadInputRefusesOverBoundBlobBeforeBody, TestTraceFixtureRefusesOverBoundFile and TestBlobBytesWithinReportsOverBoundHeader feed bound+1 and the exact bound.
